title: Italian-Style Baked Haddock
description: A flavorful Italian-inspired dish featuring pan-seared haddock baked with a zesty miso glaze.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place haddock fillets on the baking sheet.
Mix zesty miso paste and Jamaican allspice (if using) in a small bowl.
Brush the miso glaze over the haddock fillets.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve immediately with a side of your choice in a bowl.
